svg.title: experiments.py architecture
svg.desc: Diagram showing the 8 experimental studies in experiments.py and the research hypotheses they test
svg.text: transforms prototype into research: hypotheses become measurable, phenomena become observable

g.text: Root structural certainty → Search trajectory evolution → Residual collapse → Persistence → Exact search efficiency
Measures nodes, runtime, first incumbent depth,
Tests: does residual ambiguity collapse earlier?
Does uncertainty naturally stabilise in search?
density, active vertices, local gain together.
Models search as a dynamical system.
Do certainty-guided gains survive at larger
scale? Plots both normal and log-scale nodes.
When does structural guidance help most?
Sweeps graph density, measures relative gains.
Isolates: lp_only vs mwua_only vs lp+mwua
vs full (+ local structure + depth decay).
root certainty persists very deep into search.
Are improvements caused by reductions alone?
Critical control: if reductions only help
Studies pruning distribution over depth. Reveals early stabilisation, late pruning,
search collapse phases. More informative than total pruning counts alone.
Each experiment tests one part of the structural persistence hypothesis:
does certainty persist? (backbone) · does ambiguity collapse? (certainty evolution)
does structure simplify? (residual density) · does scale help? (scaling)
which signals matter? (MWUA ablation) · are gains genuine? (reductions control)
